entries.zh: 持（执持在手）；系于他人，倚靠于彼
entries.en: to be held (in one's keeping); to depend on him
entries.notes: 西语词头 puma/numa 存疑无法确读，释义依汉字「持」与西语 depender del-（倚靠于彼）补足

entries.zh: 持守（牢牢执守不失）；坚守
entries.en: to hold fast, keep firmly; to maintain
entries.notes: 西语词头 numma/puma 存疑无法确读，释义依汉字「持守」与西语 depender del- 补足

entries.en: to stand at someone's side; to attend upon
to be alone, singly

entries.zh: 把守港门（扼守港口出入口）
entries.en: to hold or guard the mouth of the harbor
entries.notes: M 栏含 T99（污损难辨），西语尾段 ella bravon 难解；释义依汉字「把港」

entries.en: to be a maiden; an unmarried woman still at home

entries.zh: 权且一时（暂且逗留，非久居）
entries.en: to be passing through; to stay for the time being, temporarily
entries.notes: 「且權時」第二字存疑（權/榷），权按「權」读，义为权且一时

entries.zh: 净化；洁净（礼仪或身心之洁净）
entries.en: purification; to be cleansed
entries.notes: 西语词头严重讹误不可读，en 依汉字「淨化」给出，对应西语原词无法确认

entries.zh: 神落入心中（神明降附于心）
entries.en: the spirit/god descends into the heart; to dwell within the heart
entries.notes: 西语词头 enel capo, sobre auiso- 与汉字句对应无法确解，释义依汉字「神在心內落」

entries.en: to be at home; to reside in the house
to be in heaven

entries.zh: 长短脚（两脚一长一短，如鹤独立之状）
entries.en: to have one leg long and one short; to stand uneven-legged, like a crane

entries.zh: 长短脚而立（单脚独立，作鹤立状）
entries.en: to stand on one leg, like a crane
to be on both sides; left and right
this (demonstrative)
this time; now, at present
the present time; this moment
the present time; nowadays
this world; the present life
this year
